meta.parties: De Silva v. William Et Al

rules.statement: When a court has to decide a question of res judicata in respect of the shares allotted to the parties in a previous partition action, the decree alone need be considered. However, if the decree contains an arithmetical error, it may be construed with reference to the judgment.
